text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huff... Wheeze... Perfect! Now for my drink!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Look, look! It's a new super

carbonated soda!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to drink it ASAP, so I just went
full turbo
around the track to be as
thirsty as possible!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, was the bottle this big and bulgy
before?
Oh well, time to open it up and
take a big swig!
